description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-13. -->
## New features

- **Music — Our own crossfade:** Rewritten to fade the audio itself, rather than raise the player's volume.
  This fixes the loud burst at the start of the next song reported on a Poco X6 with the YouTube Music
  equalizer turned on. Song/video switching works with crossfade on, including during an overlap, without
  starting another fade. Pause, seek and playback speed keep the fade in step with the music. The first song
  starts normally, paused outgoing songs stay silent, and the last song plays to its end. Repeat one and
  Repeat all still crossfade. Requires YouTube Music 9.00 or newer.
- **Music — Always play the song version:** With Music's **Don't play music videos** enabled, replace matching
  official videos in the queue with their song versions. Off by default. Tracks without an exact match and
  downloaded stream copies stay unchanged. Takes priority over **Play albums songs**; manual switching remains
  available with **Disable music video in album**.
- **Music — Disable audio ducking:** An optional Player setting stops notifications from lowering the music
  volume. Off by default; spoken-content pause behavior is preserved.
- **YouTube and Music — Patches update notice:** Check daily or manually for new patches, read release notes,
  and open Morphe Manager to re-patch. Choose **Off**, **Stable** or **Development** in Miscellaneous, postpone
  a notice or skip a version. Development checks both channels. It does not download or install APKs.

## Fixes and improvements

- **Music — Song/video and album versions:** Album tracks resolve to their own matching song, not another
  track's queue position. Low-score counterparts no longer open a Mix or the wrong video. Switching back
  returns to the same track; automatic replacement preserves downloaded audio and video copies and Jam queues.
- **Music — Downloaded playback:** Forward and backward seeks keep their target when a local stream copy
  plays online, in both Song and Video mode and through notification controls.
- **Music — Debug logs:** Export the RVX log buffer from Miscellaneous, with a matching settings icon.
  Cancelling a settings export no longer changes a later log export. Added debug-only crossfade diagnostics.
- **YouTube and Music — Settings:** Fix a crash in list preferences when new options receive a new-setting marker.
- **YouTube — Playlist downloads:** Clearer selection buttons in light and dark themes, a smaller Edit button,
  and scrolling that keeps Download and selection actions accessible.
- **YouTube — About:** App details and the recorded patch list are together under **About > Patch information**.
  The list distinguishes recorded inclusion from patcher execution results. Corrected the Reseam project name
  in Credits.
